limitations_and_claim_restrictions: Zero-column validation cannot detect nonfinite or overflow in omitted derivative values. Full parent/final linearizations still compute/check those values; do not claim universal preservation of every prior derivative-admissibility failure on arbitrary corrupted/extreme inputs.

The validated experimental scope is finite admissible data. The completed unit suites alone do not establish exact GNSS objective, nuisance-state, prior or covariance equality; the separately running cost03 off/on profiles supply that evidence.
No whole nonlinear fit,72h pulse recovery,48h GNSS memory fix, scientific superiority or speedup is established by this source review.
Default numerical behavior on valid inputs is preserved; additive error receipts and stronger malformed-zero-replay guards change failure diagnostics/policy and should be described explicitly.
